def longest_repeated_substring(s):
    n = len(s)
    max_length = 0
    
    # Create a dictionary to store suffixes and their starting indices
    suffixes = {}
    
    # Iterate over all suffixes of the string
    for i in range(n):
        suffix = s[i:]
        if suffix in suffixes:
            # If the suffix is already seen, calculate the length of the repeated substring
            length = n - i
            max_length = max(max_length, length)
        else:
            # Otherwise, add the suffix to the dictionary
            suffixes[suffix] = i
    
    return max_length
